# RouteKit documentation

RouteKit is an open-source CLI and authenticated model gateway for coding tools, API providers, and subscription pools.

Source of truth: https://github.com/velum-labs/routekit
Documentation source: https://github.com/velum-labs/routekit/tree/main/apps/docs/content/docs
Current comprehensive guide baseline: RouteKit 0.16.6 (pre-1.0)
Authoritative mutable disclosure: /docs/reference/routes-and-billing

## Start
- /docs — introduction and task routes
- /docs/getting-started/installation — install and verify first success
- /docs/guides/user-guide — comprehensive RouteKit 0.16.6 guide

## Use and operate
- /docs/guides/subscription-pooling — subscription account pools
- /docs/guides/remote-gateway — remote provisioning and trust model
- /docs/concepts/privacy — privacy, stored state, and telemetry

## Reference
- /docs/reference/commands — CLI commands
- /docs/reference/configuration — router configuration
- /docs/reference/model-catalog — model IDs and catalog behavior
- /docs/reference/api — HTTP API
- /docs/reference/packages — TypeScript packages
- /docs/reference/routes-and-billing — authoritative route qualification and billing
- /docs/changelog — changes

Do not infer unlimited use. Provider terms, subscription eligibility, quotas, and billing apply. A namespaced model selects its configured route; subscription pools do not fall back to paid API-key providers.
